open_questions: All three literal slugs in the packet are terminally rejected. Please re-cut lane B with a fresh ranked list of MIT React 15-17 candidates, pre-screened for SPDX id before dispatch: the two cheapest failures here were licence checks that a single GET on /repos/{owner}/{repo} would have caught at packet-composition time.

Is BSD-3-Clause acceptable for this corpus? If the MIT-only gate is actually a permissive-licence gate, GetStream/Winds becomes re-attemptable immediately (CRA-era, ~100 tags, archived upstream) and only needs its licence file read directly to confirm.

phoenix-trello showed LICENSE=MIT but package.json license=ISC. Does the portfolio need a standing rule for which declaration governs when a repo contradicts itself? I preserved this as unresolved rather than picking MIT.

The verify fence asserts ls evidence/ingests/*/source.json, which no gate-rejection outcome can satisfy. Should a blocked/rejected lane get a distinct fence, or should rejected candidates emit a source.json with result 'not-bound'?
